title: W3Schools: Mean and Population Standard Deviation
description: Given a list of numbers `nums`, return `[mean, std_dev]` where both are rounded to 2 decimal places. Population standard deviation: sqrt(sum((x - mean)^2) / N).
solution:
def mean_and_std(nums: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    n = len(nums)
    mean = sum(nums) / n
    variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in nums) / n
    std = variance ** 0.5
    return [round(mean, 2), round(std, 2)]
explanation: Computes statistical mean and population standard deviation in O(N) time.
